title: Code of Criminal Procedure Punjab Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Punjab Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2020
ACT IV OF 2020
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
20th May, 2020]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(48)/2020/2246, dated 20.5.2020.---The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 2020, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 11, 2020, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 18, 2020, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is
necessary further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of 1898) for
the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it
enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act,
2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Amendment in section 14A of the Act V of 1898

ACT IV OF 2020
ACT IV OF 2020
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
20th May, 2020]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(48)/2020/2246, dated 20.5.2020.---The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 2020, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 11, 2020, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 18, 2020, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is
necessary further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of 1898) for
the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it
enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
in section 14A of the Act V of 1898.---In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of 1898), in section 14A,
in subsection (2), for the "full stop" at the end, a
"comma" shall be substituted, and thereafter, the following
expression shall be added:
"forests,
mines and minerals, food adulteration, food safety, encroachments on public
lands or lands owned by the Government, canal and drainage, dangerous driving
and violation of route permits, safety and design of buildings, land use and
municipal services.".
